player_prompt.intro:
Uwite Umukino {player_id} mu SimpleTak.
Ku kibando, amashyo yawe akaza kuonekwa nk' '{player_stone}' na amashyo ya mukino wawe akaza kuonekwa nk' '{opponent_stone}'.

Muri igihe cy'ukwe, hitamo kigo kimwe gifungiye (n'indambi yacyo) na uweke amashyo yawe haho.
Kwa mfano, '[12]' ruweke amashyo yawe mu kigo 12.

Itegeko ryawe ni gukora urugero rw'amashyo yawe rutunganye ibihe bibiri byoroshye by'ikibando (kuva hejuru hadi hasi cyangwa kuva kubere hadi kurya).

invalid_move.cell_out_of_range: Umubare w'urwambariro udakwiriye {cell_num}. Ugomba kuba uri hagati ya 0 na {max_board_num} .
invalid_move.cell_already_occupied: Icyumba {cell_num} cyamaze guturwa. Hitamo icyumba kidafite umuntu.

action.placement: Umukino {current_player_id} watanze ibarurisho ryawe ({symbol}) mu kigo {cell_num}.

outcome.draw: The board is full. It's a draw!
